Name: Playstation Cursors Loader (CP)
Author: Warilized
TagLine: Re-Introducing the "Cursors Loader" with Playstation Controller Button by DrexomXander!
Description:
Re-Introducing the "Cursors Loader" with Playstation Controller Button by [DrexomXander](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15040154)!
Modding Cursors made easy! Easily replace cursors sprites without affecting other sprites in Cursors.xnb The neat Cursors Loader that loads only the cursors sprite, duh.

-------------------------------**About this mod:**
This is originally a cursor loader mod. It uses EditImage so it loads custom cursors and only the cursors sprites, minimizing conflict with another mod.
This mods loads .png and .xnb, but if both file are present .png will take precedence to avoid conflicts.

This mod has been repurposed to be Playstation Controller Button Reloader. But if you wanted to load other deprecated cursor just drop the folder with the PNG and type it's folder name in the config.

**About this mod:**

*   Fix Bug
**Installation:**

1.  First, you need to have [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) and [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400), or else this mod is useless.

2.  Delete older version.

3.  Unzip this mod to "Mods" folder.

4.  Done.
**Uninstallation:**

1.  Delete the mod.

2.  Done.
**This Mod Contains:**

*   Freely to use Content Patcher script (content.json). Credit is not necessary but appreciated.

*   "[Playstation controller buttons](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/381)" by [DrexomXander](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15040154) .
**Configurations:**

*   Enable Mod "True/False" - Enable the mod

*   Load From: "Folder Name" - The name of the cursor pack folder you wanted to load from.
**Adding Cursor Spritesheet/Sprite File:**

1.  Download a mod that change the cursor if you haven't already. I recommend cursor in the recommended section.

2.  Place the file (.xnb* or .png) on the "assets" folder of this mod. This mod accept a whole spritesheet or only specific spritesheet area even if it's are .png.

3.  Done.
*.xnb spritesheet is not recommended unless it matches your game version. Using .xnb may crash your game.

**Making/Editing Cursor Sprite:**

1.  You need [xnbcli](https://github.com/LeonBlade/xnbcli/releases) to unpack XNB files. If it's already PNG skip to step 3

2.  Place Cursors.xnb in "Pack" folder then click "Unpack.exe", your unpacked files will be placed in "Unpack" folder.

3.  Edit your Cursors.png with an image editor that supports transparency like paint.net

4.  Place your edited Cursor.png to the mod's "assets" folder or pack the .png files as .xnb again.

5.  Done.

6.  Alternatively you can just edit the files in the optional File as template/reference.

7.  You can upload it anywhere with the loader.
**Planned Updates:**

*   TBD.
**Disclaimer:**
This mod is only available only on NexusMods under "Warilized" username.

**Compatibility Issues:**

*   Mods that replaces the same area in the "Cursors.xnb".
**Recommended Cursors:**

*   "[Playstation controller buttons (Deleted)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/381)" by [DrexomXander](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15040154)  (Has been included).

*   Cursors designed for SDV 1.3.33 may work
**Credits:**

*   Template Sprite is courtesy of Concerned Ape

*   "Playstation Controller Buttons" is made by [DrexomXander](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/15040154) .
